Name: Introducing Zia - New NPC (Overriding Clint)
Author: Lightofella
Description:
This mod was created for one of my finals in my college class. Me and my partner Karen has about three weeks to complete this mod. It's not fully finished but about 70% of the mod is done. I will continue updating this mod until its fully finished and fleshed out. Let me know if y'all run into any bugs or "clint dialogue/sprites." I could only playtest so much of this mod so not 100% sure that everything works. If you enjoy this mod leave it a like and let me know! I would love to add more features in the future.

Install both SMAPI and Content Patcher for this mod. Both can be found under requirements. After installing both you'll see a mods folder within your Stardew valley files. Unzip and put this mod into your mods folder. Once you do that the mod should run smoothly! Also, if the sprites are not showing up properly trying to unpack the content using an Xnb extractor!

Downloads.Description: This mod requires SMAPI and Content Patcher! Make sure you have those installed before you start playing!!
